messages:
lucy: Heads-up: we've got a cluster of fncall validation failures in eu-west hitting dedicated tenants. Customer reported being charged even though the request rejected. anyone seen this pattern?
omar: link the alert?
lucy: `rate(fncall_validation_failures_total[1m]) by (account,route)` shows a spike from 0.01 -> 0.8% since 09:42 UTC. Top routes: /v1/invoke-tool, /v1/execute. Affected tenants: acct-9b, acct-lunar.
billingbot: Alert: fncall_validation_failures_total > 0.5% for eu-west (5m).
vik: any sample errors? shapes, enums, missing fields?
lucy: sample log: ```validation_error: "invalid_type: expected object for 'tool_args' but got array" payload: ["a","b"] route: execute-tool-v2 validator_id: v3.1```
nina: looks like callers switched to positional arrays for tool args. That is a contract break. We should not treat these as billable token events.
omar: gateway currently emits usage (billable_tokens) when request accepted before validation. so cost shows up even when we later reject.
vik: short-term mitigation: add an explicit event label `validation_status=REJECT` on the usage stream so billing can zero-rate those. low-risk change to event payload.
omic: (typo) omar: also add `validation_reason` and `schema_id` tags to traces so we can filter easily in the console. increment a metric `fncall.validation_rejects_total{route,account,reason}`.
nina: console UX: we should surface a small panel: Validation rejects (count + pct) per account with a 50-sample sanitized payload viewer. Support wants proof clips.
lucy: customer ticket #S-921: acct-9b shows ~1.8k rejects and ~USD 9 historically charged. They want credits.
omar: billing: we can zero-rate events with `validation_status=REJECT` and backfill credits for affected accounts. Need finance signoff for retro credits.
vik: concern: if we stop counting those events toward quota, customers who rely on attempt counts might be confused. Propose emit two counters: `fncall.attempts_total` (always incremented) and `fncall.billable_tokens` (only for accepted flows).
nina: good idea. That preserves attempts telemetry while fixing billing mismatch. UX note: add a short explainer in Console under Usage -> Errors explaining what "validation reject" means.
lucy: operational plan: 1) gateway patch to tag events + add metric, 2) canary deploy to dedicated cluster, 3) small billing pipeline change to ignore rejects for cost calculation, 4) console panel PR + support outreach.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: gateway/1.4.0 -> dedicated-eu-west in 4m (manual approval required).
omar: i'll own gateway PR and metrics. vik -> billing change. nina -> console and support template. lucy -> outreach and coord with finance.
lucy: thanks. if spike stays >1% for 10m i'll page oncall. :eyes:
billingbot: Note: will escalate to finance on request for retro credits if impacted_charge_total > 5 USD for an account.
